name: Career-Ops
description: Job-search system that runs inside a coding-agent CLI to scan job portals, score roles, tailor CVs and track applications.
whatItDoes: Automates the research side of job hunting: finding postings, evaluating fit, generating tailored CV PDFs and cover letters and keeping a tracker. The user reviews and submits applications personally.
howItWorks: The project is a set of modes, skills and Node scripts that a coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or OpenCode executes, using Playwright to read portals. A profile file and portal list configure it, and a local dashboard shows the pipeline.

requirements.name: Coding agent CLI
requirements.description: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode or similar

requirements.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
requirements.description: For the standalone Gemini evaluation script

models: Whatever the host coding agent uses; optional Gemini
